review: W112 synchronized-cache successor review, private candidate only

priorBaseline.preservedFinding: The unchanged reviewer oracle confirmed two simultaneous unique misses could grow a 7-entry cache to 9 entries. This successor adds a lock and addresses that finding; the original report remains intact.

tests.result: 10/10 unchanged producer cases passed against successor

freshReviewerCases: same-size/same-mtime source replacement returns pixels and digest for replacement bytes
alpha-bearing source preserves [0,64,192,255] alpha and header digest
two concurrent distinct misses scheduled before insertion both succeed and leave exactly eight cache entries
two concurrent same-key misses succeed and leave one entry
source replacement after snapshot returns 409 and does not cache stale bytes
reviewedChange: A threading.Lock now protects cache lookup and insertion/eviction; image decode and final source hash remain outside the lock. Insertion evicts under lock until there is room and avoids needless eviction when another request already inserted the same key.
limits: The eight-entry bound is an item-count bound, not a byte budget. PNG entry sizes and per-request source snapshots can be large.

A request still reads the entire source into memory, then streams the path again for race verification. Prior reviewer measured two source-length reads per hit and miss; the successor changes only synchronization and retains that cost.
Route-level candidate validation only. Client acceptance of the digest header, launcher startup, and live server integration are not claimed.
Synthetic temporary fixtures only; no customer data, provider, native app, live server, or external endpoint used.
